# Potential Energy Landscape of Alanine Dipeptide

Visualize the free energy surface F(phi, psi) of alanine dipeptide by sampling
configurations via Langevin MD and histogramming the backbone dihedral angles.
The key insight: `jax.vmap` lets us evaluate energies and dihedrals across
thousands of frames in a single vectorized call.

## Run

```bash
python examples/energy_landscape/energy_landscape.py
```

This is jupytext "percent" Python, so `# %%` marks a cell. With jupytext
installed you can open it as a notebook directly, or convert it:

```bash
jupytext --to ipynb examples/energy_landscape/energy_landscape.py
```

## Figures

`plt.show()` is a no-op on a headless machine, so nothing is written by
default. To save the figures to `output/` (gitignored):

```bash
python tools/render_examples.py --only energy_landscape
```

This example uses the 3D viewers in `jaxmm.notebook`, so it needs `py3Dmol`:

```bash
pip install -e ".[examples]"
```
